evals.name: stryker-irvine-two-transfers
evals.prompt: TRANSFER 1 — 3/20, 7:40am · 18000 Von Karman Ave → 6001 Oak Canyon, Irvine CA · One-way morning · 80 passengers. TRANSFER 2 — 3/20, 2:15pm · 6001 Oak Canyon → 18000 Von Karman Ave · 25 passengers. Client is Stryker via BCD; use the Yerdle test profile.
evals.expected_output: Two units (per date/leg), passenger_count 80 and 25, no quantity, candidate ids [7,26] and [7,26]. Client + stops resolved in one turn. One quoting question. Summary shows value + elevated per unit and one Option A total. No passenger lookup. No discount/fuel/cover questions.

assertions.name: one-tool-search
assertions.check: exactly one tool_search call, naming all four tools

assertions.name: parallel-resolve
assertions.check: resolve_client and resolve_itinerary_stops are called in the same turn

assertions.name: no-passengers
assertions.check: resolve_passengers is never called

assertions.name: one-quote-call
assertions.check: exactly one plan_approximate_quote_units call with 2 units

assertions.name: single-question
assertions.check: one quoting question (rate sheet? best/options/define) and nothing about discount, fuel, cover, or personalization

assertions.name: summary-from-script
assertions.check: the chat summary is the handoff.py summarize output, not hand-written

assertions.name: rate-sheet-question-always
assertions.check: the rate-sheet question is asked on every quote, even when the request seems self-evident

assertions.name: airport-stops-have-flight
assertions.check: every airport stop in the payload carries a flight object with the right flight_type (arrival when it's the pickup)

assertions.name: no-probe-on-validation-error
assertions.check: a validation error is fixed at the named path and resent once; no cut-down test unit is sent
